settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Your personal preferences and the system configuration.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.subtitle: Theme, language and motion preferences are stored in this browser.
appearance.languageHint: Your choice applies to you only; admins set the system default.
appearance.motionHint: When off, transitions and entry animations are not shown. If “reduce motion” is on in your OS, animations are already shortened.
appearance.compactHint: Tighter table rows: more logs in the same space.

account.title: Account
account.subtitle: Your profile and password.
account.profileFailed: The profile could not be updated.
account.passwordTooShort: The new password needs at least 8 characters
account.passwordFailed: The password could not be changed.

notifications.title: Notification preferences
notifications.subtitle: Choose the channels you receive alarms on.
notifications.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved.

email.title: Email
email.description: Sends alarms to your profile address through the server's SMTP account.
email.noSmtp: SMTP is not configured on the server, so no emails are sent. Ask your admin to set SMTP_HOST and the related settings.
email.noAddress: Your profile has no email address. <link>Add one in account settings</link>.
email.testFailed: The email could not be sent.

slack.title: Slack
slack.description: Posts errors and warnings to the chosen channel as they happen.
slack.testSent: Test message sent to the Slack channel.
slack.testFailed: The test message could not be sent.

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.description: POSTs alarms as JSON to your own system (https).
webhook.urlHint: Must be a public https:// address. Body: {body}

push.title: Browser notifications
push.description: While the app is open, alarms appear in the corner with a sound.
push.testFailed: The notification could not be triggered.

mobile.title: Mobile notifications
mobile.description: Sends push notifications to the mobile app.

system.title: System preferences
system.subtitle: Retention, analysis and language settings for every user.
system.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved.
system.retentionHint: Logs are deleted from the database after this period.
system.engineHint: The engine used for error groups.
system.aiOff: AI analysis is off on this server (AI_ENABLED / OPENAI_API_KEY not set).
system.aiOffSelected: Although AI is selected, analyses run on the rule-based engine.
system.aiPrivacy: With AI selected, error messages and stack traces are sent to OpenAI (USA) for analysis. Logs that may contain personal data can require explicit consent under KVKK/GDPR.
system.languageHint: Users who have not picked a language see the interface in this one.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Role changes take effect when the user's session is renewed.
users.resetDescription: The user has to change it at the next sign-in.
users.deleteDescription: The user and their notification settings are deleted permanently.
users.tempPasswordHint: The user has to change it at first sign-in.

roleDescriptions.ADMIN: Everything: deleting, system settings, user management
roleDescriptions.EDITOR: Edits sources and rules, acknowledges and resolves alarms

toast.created: User created; they will change the password at first sign-in.
toast.createFailed: The user could not be created.
toast.roleChanged: Role updated. It applies at the user's next session renewal.
toast.roleFailed: The role could not be updated.
toast.reset: Password reset; the user changes it at first sign-in.
toast.resetFailed: The password could not be reset.
toast.deleteFailed: The user could not be deleted.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.subtitle: Scoped keys for CI and integrations. A key can only call the endpoints of the scopes it was given.
apiKeys.emptyHint: Create a key with the deployments:write scope to record deployments from CI.
apiKeys.revokeDescription: CI jobs and integrations using this key start getting 401 right away. This cannot be undone.

created.title: Key created
created.warning: Copy this key now. For security it is never shown again; if it is lost, revoke it and create a new one.

toast.createFailed: The key could not be created.
toast.revokeFailed: The key could not be revoked.
